description: Retrieve one MCP server by id or slug. Returns server details including the parent integration, status, and created time; use get_mcp_server for the server record, and get_mcp_integration for the parent integration's URL, auth, and transport configuration.

id.description: The MCP server ID or slug to retrieve

name: get_mcp_server

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
